GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 423 (21 Dec 45) ESS-IE
(SCAPIN - 475)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Release of Silk
1. It is directed that silk, as described below, be released to Army Exchange Central Purchasing Office for sale to the Occupation Forces.
a. 1,000 bolts 12 m/m 36" White Habutai
b. 3,000 bolts 14 m/m 36" White Habutai
c. 1,000 bolts 16 m/m 36" White Habutai
d. 4,000 bolts 20 m/m 36" White Habutai
2. This directive permits AECPO to make substitutions as to types, weights, colours and widths within allocations.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will furnish this headquarters with bills of sale with reference to the release of the above specified quantity of silk.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
